answer: Use proof-of-work memory puzzles tied to each key and epoch. At registration, the registry sends a fresh seed; the agent must solve a memory-hard puzzle, such as filling 2 GB of RAM with hashes, then submit a short proof that verifiers check in milliseconds. The proof expires every epoch, so a hollow pool of keys must keep re-solving. A nebula of fakes needs parallel machines, and an atlas of valid proofs shows who is current. Each fake costs roughly eight dollars of rented compute monthly.
